description: This file manages HTTP request headers within the WebKit browser extension, including setting, removing, and applying headers for web pages, with integration for AAMP bindings.

methods.name: ParseHeaders
methods.description: Parses JSON string into headers vector, logging success or errors.

methods.name: RemoveRequestHeaders
methods.description: Removes stored headers for a given WebKitWebPage.

methods.name: SetRequestHeaders
methods.description: Sets headers for a WebKitWebPage from a WebKitUserMessage, including optional AAMP integration.

methods.name: ApplyRequestHeaders
methods.description: Applies stored headers to a WebKitURIRequest for a given WebKitWebPage.
